ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level ratio; approximately 5-8% high-intensity white pixels (spots) distributed against a dominant 92-95% low-intensity black surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-contrast white punctate blobs distributed across the surface. Notable clusters are mapped to the central-left lobe and lower-mid section, with scattered individual spots across the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern. The right lobe displays high-amplitude jagged peaks (approximately 4-8 distinct deep notches), while the left lobe shows a lower-amplitude, more continuous serrated edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve fitted to the outer boundaries, showing an upward and outward sweep from the peduncle attachment point.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical and slightly diagonal white linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the left lobe and lower central fluke area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe traumatic tissue loss on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe, resulting in an irregular, saw-toothed geometric profile compared to the more intact left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, prominent jagged peak/projection located near the furthest distal tip of the right lobe.
